question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to the Control UI, or should long-prompt friction be handled through inline composer ergonomics and the existing send-shortcut setting?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing composer mode with draft ownership, keyboard, focus, attachment, and send semantics rather than fixing a broken current contract.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement a scoped modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Ergonomics
options.body: Improve long prompts through inline growth, resizing, compact pasted-text handling, and the existing shortcut preference without adding a modal mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if the Control UI composer should stay lean and modal composition should not live in core.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement a scoped modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied prior issue review, authored the adjacent shortcut work, and have the strongest current-main history on the composer keyboard/control surface.
